purpose: Cross-instance replication / falsification of Paper-6 structural observability after the literature audit.

instances.name: BAL3_L4_Q1
instances.library_definition: Full L4 aa2fr blocks with all three letters present; 30 blocks.

measurements.descriptor: recency frame + 1 recent block profile + adjacency bit

instances.conclusion: Full future is already observable from two recent profiles without the bit; alternatively one profile plus the bit suffices. The bit is not universally necessary.

instances.name: FULL_L4_Q1

measurements.descriptor: recency frame + 2 recent block profiles + adjacency bit

instances.conclusion: Three recent recency-canonicalized block profiles are the first tested profile-window depth with complete full/persistent observability. The adjacency bit does not rescue depth two.

instances.name: FULL_L4_Q2

measurements.descriptor: recency frame + 4 recent block profiles + adjacency bit
recency frame + 4 recent block profiles + full age_b in {1,2,3}

instances.conclusion: At Q2, four profiles alone miss 35 full-future dimensions; one adjacency bit is sufficient and full age information adds no rank.

instances.name: INTERIOR_L5_Q1
instances.library_definition: All 90 L5 aa2fr blocks containing all three letters.

measurements.descriptor: recency frame + 2 recent block profiles + adjacency bit

instances.conclusion: Cross-block-length replication: three recent profiles give complete exact observability; the bit is not required.

instances.name: HASH30_L4_K5_ASYMMETRIC_CONTROL
instances.library_definition: 30 full-L4 aa2fr blocks with lexicographically smallest SHA-256 digest.

measurements.descriptor: recency canonicalization + 2 recent block profiles + adjacency bit
fixed a,b,c orientation + 2 recent block profiles

instances.conclusion: Strong negative control: quotienting alphabet orientation by a symmetry the selected library does not possess loses exact future information. Keeping the actual trivial symmetry gauge restores full observability.

main_findings: Structural observability replicates across L=4 and L=5 and across multiple selected libraries.
The exact descriptor is not universal: required profile depth and the need for the adjacency bit depend on the selected library and block range.
The one-bit correction is specific to the harder FULL_L4_Q2 calibration among the tested S3-invariant instances; it is not a universal axiom.
Alphabet gauge must respect the actual automorphism group G_B of the selected library. Full S3 recency canonicalization is unsound as a generic measurement compression for asymmetric HASH30.
In the tested S3-invariant Q1 systems, a small recent-profile window alone gives complete full and persistent observability: depth 2 for BAL3 L4 and depth 3 for FULL L4 and INTERIOR L5.
FULL_L4 exhibits a real Q1 -> Q2 increase in structural measurement complexity: 3 profiles at Q1 versus 4 profiles plus one adjacency bit at Q2.
novelty_implication: The v2.0 theorem should not be universalized as 'four profiles plus one bit always suffice'. The more credible research direction is a library/range-dependent structural measurement theorem whose gauge is the actual alphabet symmetry group and whose required depth/decorations are derived from the Abelian boundary geometry.
